## Purpose and public entry points
Needle is a Python package for local, constrained tool-calling inference, structured extraction, LoRA fine-tuning, and export of compact `.cact` model binaries. Primary library APIs are exposed through `needle/__init__.py`; command-line commands are implemented by `needle/cli.py`. The optional browser playground is served by `needle/playground/server.py`.

## Agent runtime and tool loop
`Needle` orchestrates a session: accept user text, select/render relevant tools, request constrained model completion, execute selected Python tools, feed results back, and return structured output plus confidence. Tool declaration/introspection and execution contracts are centered in `needle/agent/tools.py`, while engine acquisition/loading is separated into `needle/agent/fetch.py`.

## Model execution boundary
The Python package does not implement the production inference engine itself; it fetches and caches a prebuilt engine/weights artifact, then invokes it for offline inference. This creates a hard boundary between Python-facing orchestration and the self-contained quantized binary runtime. Model architecture definitions and inference-side support live in `needle/model/architecture.py` and `needle/model/run.py`.

## Constrained decoding and extraction
Tool arguments and extraction outputs are constrained to schemas through byte-level grammar-aware decoding, producing JSON-compatible structured results rather than unconstrained text. Tokenization and decoding are distinct stages in `needle/model/tokenizer.py` and `needle/model/decode.py`. The same runtime path supports direct completions, schema extraction, and agent tool calls.

## Fine-tuning pipeline
Training uses JAX-based LoRA over a frozen base checkpoint. The pipeline consumes JSONL tool-call examples, optionally generates/augments examples via an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint, trains an adapter, then preserves deployment compatibility by merging it into the base before export. Core training logic is in `needle/model/finetune.py`; CLI-driven data synthesis is part of `needle/cli.py`.

## Build, quantization, and distribution
Export merges a base checkpoint and optional LoRA adapter, quantizes model weights, and emits a portable `.cact` artifact consumable by the same inference engine. These transformations are separated into `needle/model/export.py` and `needle/model/quantize.py`. Artifacts may be downloaded from or uploaded to Hugging Face; engine/base checkpoint retrieval also depends on Hugging Face.

## Playground service
The playground is a local server that initializes the model before accepting requests, maintains conversational follow-ups, and can invoke fine-tuning from the UI. Backend coordination is in `needle/playground/server.py`; the static browser client is `needle/playground/index.html` and `needle/playground/app.js`.

## Runtimes and external services
Inference targets a small cached native/model engine and runs without network after setup. Fine-tuning requires Python/JAX, with optional CUDA or Apple Metal acceleration. Hugging Face supplies engine, base-model, and published `.cact` artifacts. Optional synthetic-data generation uses OpenRouter by default, or an environment-configured OpenAI-compatible gateway.
